cass-land-ownership-dlan.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = DNR Major 8 'Leech Lake River' (HUC8 07010102) polygon from watershed-whole-basin.geojson, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; full 4,776-vertex polygon
cass-land-ownership-dlan.geojson.caveats: DLAN basemap Land Ownership -- the DLAN equivalent of the county's Ownership layer, NOT the county Ownership layer itself (that layer has no public endpoint). OWNAME, all OWADR/OWZIP, PHYSADDR/PHYSCITY/PHYSZIP, APTAXP, TDTDNM, TPLAND/TPBLDG, ESTTOTVAL, TOTTAXVAL, TPNTAX, TPTASM, PENALTY, BALDUE, CALL_AUDITOR and RECNUM dropped: no owner names, addresses, or tax/valuation figures are stored. OWNERSHIP is the ownership category (e.g. Tribal, Tax Forfeited, County Fee, State, Federal). FIELD FENCE: owner/taxpayer names, mailing/situs addresses, EMV/valuation, tax amounts/balances, mortgage/payment details and staff/editor names were NOT requested or stored. OWNERSHIP CODE TABLE MISSING: OWNERSHIP is a numeric code (80: 16,373 features; 10: 2,017; 99: 832; 30: 776; 20: 670; 40: 356; 110: 292; 75: 149; 41: 100; 94: 53) and the service carries NO coded-value domain for it (checked live 2026-11-21). The code meanings must come from the county's Link viewer legend or GIS office -- do NOT guess them at wire-in.
